title: Delivery Atlas
teaser: Resource tracking and taxonomy cleanup work for AI-assisted delivery operations.
headline: A delivery system view that made resource movement and taxonomy cleanup easier to reason about.
challenge: The work sat between project delivery, data structure, and operational training, which meant the product problem was as much organizational as it was technical.
outcome: Ali mapped resources, cleaned structural patterns, and prepared the information model for a SharePoint AI agent workflow with clearer operating logic.
bullets: Tracked 14 resources through agile delivery to support safety risk training.
Improved project delivery speed by 80% through tighter delivery coordination.
Researched system data models and taxonomy cleanup patterns to support a SharePoint AI agent workflow.
